These endeavors advance the levels of scholarship at Colby and strengthen the engagement between students and faculty. About

The Colby Undergraduate Summer Research Retreat (CUSRR) is a two-day event. Day one is a scholarly symposium featuring student talks and poster presentations on a wide variety of topics. The second day features an all-day white-water rafting trip in The Forks, Maine at Crab Apple Whitewater nestled on the Kennebec River. Crab Apple Whitewater is owned by Robert Peabody ’96. 

Please email Yang Fan (Yang@colby.edu) with any questions .
